profile_text.body:
Cognigy, headquartered in Düsseldorf, Germany, describes itself as a provider of enterprise customer service AI operating under the NiCE Cognigy brand. The company positions its platform as enabling businesses to deploy AI agents across voice and chat channels, combining generative and conversational AI to deliver what it characterizes as fast and personalized service in contact center environments.

The company's core product, tracked under the Enterprise AI Platforms and Agent Orchestration category, is a conversational AI platform designed for customer service use cases. It is described as GDPR-compliant and available with EU-hosted deployment options, which the company highlights as relevant to enterprise buyers with data residency requirements.

The held facts note 14 Delaware legal exposure entries, indicating a degree of involvement with Delaware-registered entities or proceedings, though no specific litigation cases are recorded. The company maintains a verified profile with a confirmed headquarters in Düsseldorf.
